title.narrative: Early appraisal of Denmark’s country programme in Kenya 2026-2031

description.narrative: The primary purpose of the appraisal is to provide strategic and technical quality assurance and guidance for the continued programming of the KCP and secondary to provide technical quality assurance of the design and documentation of projects that are relatively advanced in their development. This will be a truly early appraisal with less focus on project details, partner capacity etc. and more on the overall direction of the programme, its ability to support underlying strategies, its focus, manageability, coherence with the existing substantial development portfolio and generally its support for the broad spectrum of engagements between Denmark and Kenya. As this is an appraisal under a new development strategy, new aid management guidelines and Kenya being the first country to go through this new approach, there will be an element of iterative learning throughout this process.

owner-org.narrative: Denmark - Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Danida

department.narrative: Department for Evaluation, Learning and Quality (LEARNING)
